## Successful Blood Donation Camp at MGIT in Collaboration with Lions Club and NSS Unit

News Date : 28 Mar 2023News ReportMGIT in association with NSS Unit and Lions Club of Hyderabad Jubilee Hills, organized a Blood Donation Camp on 28-03-2023. The event was graced by the presence of esteemed dignitaries such as MGIT Principal Prof. G. ChandraMohan Reddy, Vice Principal Prof. K Sudhakar Reddy, Lions Club of Hyderabad Jubilee Hills Board of Directors Mrs. Vijayalakshmi and Mrs. Ch. Aruna, who highlighted the importance of blood donation. We are proud to share that our college students and staff showed their active participation by donating 49 units of blood, as per NSS Programme Officer Dr. G. Bal Reddy. We extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who made this camp a grand success! #MGITBloodDonationCamp #NSSUnit #LionsClub #SaveLives #DonateBlood
